list.title: Invoices and receipts
list.description: Every invoice, receipt, proforma, credit note and debit note, newest first. An issued document never changes: it is corrected by a credit or debit note.
list.emptyBody: Invoices and receipts appear here as soon as a sale or an order issues one.
list.error: Billing documents could not be loaded
list.denied: You do not have access to invoices and receipts
list.searchLabel: Find a document by its number

doc.error: The document could not be loaded
doc.denied: You do not have access to this document
doc.issuedNever: An issued document never changes. To correct it, raise a credit note or a debit note against it.

facts.title: Details
facts.taxInclusive: Tax inclusive: the prices include the tax and levies
facts.taxExclusive: Tax exclusive: the tax and levies are added to the prices

tax.title: Tax breakdown
tax.intro: Every figure here is the API's, as the document was issued. Nothing is added up on this screen.
tax.table: Tax and levies on this document
tax.none: No tax or levy applies to this document.

settlement.title: Payment
settlement.behind: Kept by billing from payments, a few seconds behind them. As of {{when}}.

archive.title: The archived copy
archive.rendering: Being drawn up. A document is archived a few seconds after it is issued; reprints are possible once it is.
archive.draft: A draft is archived when it is issued.
archive.hashHint: The archived file's fingerprint, set once. A reprint is checked against it before it is printed.
archive.openFailed: The archived original could not be opened
archive.linkExpires: The link works until {{when}}. Opening it is logged.
archive.viewNotCopy: Viewing the original is not a copy for a customer: to give someone a copy, reprint it, and the copy is marked and numbered.
archive.noAccess: Opening the archived file needs the document archive permission (doc.document.read).
archive.error: The archived copy could not be loaded

reprints.title: Reprint history
reprints.error: The reprint history could not be loaded
reprints.none: This document has never been reprinted.

actions.title: What you can do
actions.draftHint: This credit note waits for a second person. Nothing has been posted, and it has no number yet.
actions.proformaHint: A proforma is a quote, not a demand for payment: it cannot be credited or charged.

reprint.title: Reprint this document?
reprint.body: The reprint is the archived document, unchanged, with a reprint marker and its copy number on the first page. It is not a new document and gets no new number.
reprint.logged: The copy is numbered and logged with your name and the time.
reprint.markerTitle: Reprint {{number}}: a copy, not a new document
reprint.markerBody: This is copy {{number}} of {{name}}, printed from the archive with a reprint marker. The document itself has not changed and keeps its number.
reprint.noPdf: The API sent no PDF for this reprint. Nothing was printed; try again, and quote the reference if it happens again.
reprint.unavailable: Reprints are possible once the document has been archived.
reprint.thermalOnTill: A till-printer copy of a receipt is printed at the till.

credit.title: Credit note against {{name}}
credit.intro: Credit what is being given back, line by line: a quantity, or an amount. The API works out the tax on it by the original's tax scheme, and a second person approves it before it is numbered and posted.
credit.error: The document to credit could not be loaded
credit.notCorrectable: Only an issued invoice or receipt can be credited.
credit.reasonHint: A refund or a return reason.
credit.noteHint: What happened, for the person who approves it.
credit.quantityInvalid: Enter a quantity with at most three decimal places, more than zero.
credit.amountHintInclusive: Gross, including tax, as the original's prices were. The line was {{gross}}.
credit.amountHintExclusive: Net, before tax, as the original's prices were. The line was {{net}}.
credit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount more than zero.
credit.noLines: Choose at least one line to credit.
credit.confirmTitle: Send this credit note for approval?
credit.confirmBody: Nothing is numbered or posted until a different person approves it.
credit.confirmTax: The tax and levies on it are worked out by the API from the original's tax scheme, and shown on the credit note.
credit.failed: The credit note was not raised
credit.waitingTitle: The credit note waits for approval
credit.waitingBody: Nothing has been numbered or posted. A different person who can approve credit notes decides it, with their authenticator.

debit.title: Debit note against {{name}}
debit.intro: A debit note adds a charge the original missed or undercharged. Each charge is taxed by today's tax scheme in its tax category. It is issued, numbered and posted at once.
debit.error: The document could not be loaded
debit.notCorrectable: Only an issued invoice or receipt can be charged.
debit.descriptionMissing: Say what the charge is for.
debit.amountHintInclusive: Gross, including tax, as the original's prices were.
debit.amountHintExclusive: Net, before tax, as the original's prices were.
debit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount more than zero.
debit.confirmBody: It is numbered and posted at once, against the customer, and cannot be withdrawn: a mistake is corrected with a credit note.
debit.confirmTax: The API adds the tax and levies on each charge by its tax category; the debit note shows them.
debit.failed: The debit note was not issued

statements.title: Customer statements
statements.description: What a wholesale customer was invoiced, paid and credited over a period, with the balance carried forward.
statements.emptyBody: Draw one up for a customer and a period.
statements.denied: You do not have access to customer statements

one.error: The statement could not be loaded
one.denied: You do not have access to this statement
one.title: Statement {{name}}
one.draftNote: A draft: a preview, not archived and not sent.
one.openingCredit: Opening balance in the customer's favour
one.closingCredit: Closing balance in the customer's favour

create.title: Draw up a statement
create.intro: Choose the customer and the period. A preview is a draft you can read first; issuing numbers and archives it.
create.customerSearch: Type at least two letters of the name, a phone number, or the public ID (cus_…)
create.datesMissing: Choose the first and last day of the period.
create.datesOrder: The period must end on or after the day it starts.
create.issueHint: Off: a draft preview. On: it is numbered and archived.
create.failed: The statement was not drawn up

receiptLink.title: The till’s receipt link
receiptLink.body: The till made a link to this receipt for the customer’s phone. If it went to the wrong number or the wrong customer, revoke it: from then on it opens nothing. The customer can be given the receipt number instead.
receiptLink.confirmBody: The link stops working at once and cannot be turned back on. The sale, its receipt and its money do not change.
receiptLink.reasonHint: Why, for example “Sent to the wrong number”. It is kept with who revoked it.
receiptLink.failed: The receipt link was not revoked
receiptLink.denied: You cannot revoke this receipt link
receiptLink.noLink: This sale holds no receipt link: it was sold online, its link was refused, or it has not reached the server from the till.
